patch.value: Release workflow publishes npm before advancing git main, so a protected-branch push rejection permanently desyncs npm from git

The Daily Release workflow runs Publish npm package before Push release tag and main. On 2026-08-09 at ~04:40 the daily release published 2026.8.9 to npm, then git push origin HEAD:main was rejected by the protected-branch hook (GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main). Because npm versions are immutable, npm now serves 2026.8.9 while git main is still 2026.8.7 with no tag for 2026.8.9. Any push failure permanently desynchronises npm from git. Fix: reorder so git main already contains the release commit before npm publish runs, by merging release metadata through a protected PR (merge_method=rebase, pinned release_commit sha) and verifying the merged main before publishing, then pushing a tag-only step.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fix applied to .github/workflows/release.yml. Root cause: the workflow ran 'Publish npm package' before 'Push release tag and main' (git push origin HEAD:main). On 2026-08-09 the protected-branch hook rejected that push (GH006), so npm served 2026.8.9 while git main stayed at 2026.8.7 with no tag. Ported the pm-changelog invariant so git main already contains the release commit before npm publish runs: added 'Merge release metadata through protected PR' (pushes release/<ver>, opens a PR titled 'Release pm-csv <tag>', merges via the API with merge_method=rebase and sha=<release_commit> pinned) and 'Verify merged release' (refetches origin/main, asserts the merged sha and package version, re-runs release:check, and git-diffs the exact release files). Replaced 'Push release tag and main' with a tag-only 'Push release tag' (main is already advanced by the PR). Added pull-requests: write permission (needed for gh pr create/merge) and a base_sha output to the decide step (used by the merge step's stale-main guard).
